children: Zapata Quantum announced early access to Quantum Pilot, a hardware-agnostic, cloud platform to help enterprises identify and develop high-value quantum applications.
Introduced Quantum Pilot to enable systematic discovery and development of enterprise quantum applications.
Platform is hardware-agnostic and cloud-based, allowing firms to evaluate opportunities without betting on a single provider.
Combines Quantum Graph, Quantum Engine and Quantum Assurance to link research, estimate resources, and apply formal verification.
Early access program available for select enterprise and government customers; interested organizations can request a demo.
